title: Volume change feedback sound clips and sounds bad when rapidly changing volume
line: Changing the volume quickly no longer makes the feedback sound pop or pile up into overlapping chimes.
explanation: VolumeFeedback used to cancel the chime still playing on every volume step, and cutting the sound off made it pop. MR !424 removed the cancel so chimes overlap instead, and with quick steps two or three chimes now play on top of each other and pile up. Now a step that arrives while a chime is still playing is remembered and played once that chime ends, so only one chime plays at a time, nothing is cut off, and the last step is always heard.

commits.message:
VolumeFeedback: play one chime at a time when changing volume quickly

Cancelling the chime on every volume step made it pop, and letting the
chimes overlap instead piled them up. Now a step that comes while one is
still playing waits for it to end, and only the latest step is played.

BUG: 505885

media.caption: master: 16 quick volume steps (160 ms apart) play 16 chimes, up to 3 overlapping (recorded from the sink)
fixed: the same 16 steps play 8 chimes back to back, never overlapping, ending at the same time
master waveform: chimes run into each other
fixed waveform: one chime at a time
